title: Generic command: declaration and evidence contract
description: The config block of a tool instance that uses the generic-command adapter. A generic command is an explicit executable plus args (never a shell string), with declared effects and a contract that says what its result proves. Without a findings parser the result is a well-defined boolean (exit code); only a verifiable contract lets the command cover security, architecture or tests.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the workspace; accepts {componentRoot}. Default: the workspace root (or the component root).

support.description: partial: the stack has no dedicated adapter; the plan shows the limits.

oneOf.description: Boolean check: the exit code is the whole result. It never covers security, architecture or tests.
A recognised test runner whose exit code is the verdict of the tests. May cover the tests category.

file.description: Name of the JSON file the command writes in {outputDir}.

schema.description: JSON Schema (workspace-relative path) the evidence file must satisfy.

oneOf.description: The command writes an evidence file the run validates against the declared schema; invalid evidence is an error.
